name: Habartice (Czechia)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of yellow and blue, with a cartwheel counterchanged red and yellow over the division.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 19 November 2009 (decision No. 67) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
